fields: h, caption (eyebrow), intro, rows [{p, v, m, link, link_label, part}], note. part (look-only): the drawn part the row governs, one of membranes, utilities, exchanger, edi, piping, joints, frame, pump, drain, panel. A row without a part has no tag (it still lists). Every row shows on every width (S7).
best_for: SkidSheet reads a skid's design parameters off the skid itself: one RO and EDI skid in IsoKit line art on a framed general-arrangement sheet, a numbered tag on a leader from each part to the parameter it governs, and the parameter rows beside the sheet under the same numbers.

rows.m: At your coldest feed and end of membrane life ([membrane design life, years]), not 25 °C; parallel trains above

rows.v: Pretreated feed in, PW out to storage, concentrate to drain; [supply voltage options]; [feed pressure and drain flow, per skid]; [typical footprint, m × m]
rows.m: Electrical: [panel certification mark held, or field evaluation used]
Otherwise sized at your site minimum

rows.v: [sanitization method for the PP skid]; [heat-sanitizable RO and EDI, yes or no]
rows.m: Removal of any sanitant proven (WHO TRS 1033, 4.3.6)

rows.v: Unpigmented polypropylene (PP), [PP grade]; dead legs ≤ [dead leg design limit, L/D], sloped to drain

rows.m: Single-pass RO and EDI, city feed

rows.v: [RO high-pressure section material and pressure class]
rows.m: Rated for the highest feed pressure at the coldest feed
Concentrate recycled where feed chemistry allows
